parameters.jsCode:
const item = $('Parse Inventory Result').last().json;
return [{
  json: {
    orderId: item.orderId,
    shopifyOrderId: item.shopifyOrderId,
    customerName: item.customerName,
    customerEmail: item.customerEmail,
    hasValidEmail: item.hasValidEmail,
    customerDisplay: item.customerDisplay,
    currency: item.currency,
    totalAmount: item.totalAmount,
    processedAt: item.processedAt,
    low_stock_threshold: item.low_stock_threshold,
    store_name: item.store_name,
    owner_telegram_chat_id: item.owner_telegram_chat_id,
    sender_email: item.sender_email,
    productTitle: item.productTitle,
    productDisplay: item.productDisplay,
    sku: item.sku,
    quantity: item.quantity,
    unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
    lineRevenue: item.lineRevenue,
    remainingStock: item.remainingStock,
    isLowStock: item.isLowStock,
    processedStatus: item.processedStatus,
    errorReason: '',
  },
}];

const items = $input.all().map((i) => i.json); const first = items[0] || {}; const currency = first.currency || 'PKR'; const fmtMoney = (n) => currency + ' ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); const itemLines = items.map((it, idx) => { const stockNote = it.processedStatus === 'updated' ? ('Remaining: ' + it.remainingStock + (it.isLowStock ? ' ⚠️ LOW' : '')) : ('⚠️ NOT UPDATED (' + (it.errorReason || 'Error') + ')'); return (idx + 1) + '. ' + it.productDisplay + ' x' + it.quantity + ' — ' + fmtMoney(it.lineRevenue) + ' [' + stockNote + ']'; }); const ownerTelegramText = [ '🛒 *NEW SHOPIFY ORDER ' + first.orderId + '*', '', '*Customer:* ' + first.customerDisplay, '*Processed:* ' + first.processedAt, '', '*Items:*', ...itemLines, '', '*Order Total:* ' + fmtMoney(first.totalAmount), !first.hasValidEmail ? '\n⚠️ _Customer email missing — confirmation email skipped._' : '', ].filter(Boolean).join('\n'); const esc = (s) => String(s || '') .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"'); const rowsHtml = items.map((it) => ` ${esc(it.productTitle)}${it.sku && it.sku !== 'N/A' ? '
SKU: ' + esc(it.sku) + '' : ''} ${it.quantity} ${esc(fmtMoney(it.unitPrice))} ${esc(fmtMoney(it.lineRevenue))} `).join(''); const emailHtml = `

${esc(first.store_name || 'Northern Treasures')}

Order Confirmation — ${esc(first.orderId)}

Hi ${esc(first.customerName)},

Thank you for shopping with ${esc(first.store_name || 'Northern Treasures')}! We have received your order ${esc(first.orderId)} and our team is preparing it for dispatch.

${rowsHtml}
Product Qty Unit Price Total
Order Total: ${esc(fmtMoney(first.totalAmount))}

Processed on: ${esc(first.processedAt)} (PKT)
If you have any questions about your order, simply reply to this email.

`; return [{ json: { orderId: first.orderId, customerName: first.customerName, customerEmail: first.customerEmail, hasValidEmail: first.hasValidEmail, owner_telegram_chat_id: first.owner_telegram_chat_id, sender_email: first.sender_email, store_name: first.store_name, ownerTelegramText, emailSubject: (first.store_name || 'Northern Treasures') + ' — Order Confirmation (' + first.orderId + ')', emailHtml, }, }];
